description: Confronting the conversion of a place devoted to God into a marketplace and examining the authority claimed for that intervention.
name: Cleansing of the Temple

description: Using leadership and authority for humble, practical service rather than expecting others to absorb all low-status work.
name: Jesus washes the disciples' feet

description: Giving practical and costly help to a person in danger across social boundaries instead of passing by or narrowing who counts as a neighbor.
name: Parable of the Good Samaritan

description: Distinguishing legitimate civic obligations from what belongs to God when a question is framed as a trap.
name: Render to Caesar

description: A broad foundation for actions involving love, mercy, truthful speech, enemies, possessions, prayer and putting Jesus' teaching into practice.
name: The Sermon on the Mount

description: Rejecting shortcuts that misuse power, manipulate Scripture, test God or trade faithful worship for control and prestige.
name: Temptation in the wilderness

description: Resisting a condemning trap, examining one's own guilt and extending mercy while still calling a person away from wrongdoing.
name: The woman caught in adultery

description: Welcoming a despised person while connecting repentance to concrete generosity and repayment of what was wrongfully taken.
name: Zacchaeus
